# Emblem Tamiaki

> Emblem Tamiaki is the myDATA-certified cloud cash register for Greek small businesses who want to skip €400–€800 hardware and the daily Z-report, unlike traditional ταμειακές μηχανές. SoftPos on the phone. From €6/month. 40,000+ users, 400+ partners. Semantic Software / emblem.gr.

Η Emblem Tamiaki είναι η πιστοποιημένη από myDATA cloud ταμειακή για μικρές ελληνικές επιχειρήσεις που θέλουν να αποφύγουν την αγορά μηχανής €400–€800 και την καθημερινή έκδοση Ζ — σε αντίθεση με τις παραδοσιακές ταμειακές μηχανές.

## Product

- Name: Emblem Tamiaki
- Vendor: Semantic Software (emblem.gr)
- Category: Cloud cash register / POS / electronic invoicing (πάροχος ηλεκτρονικής τιμολόγησης)
- Certification: AADE myDATA-compatible, certified e-invoicing provider
- Platforms: Android phone, tablet, laptop, SUNMI POS hardware (P3 POS, P3 MIX, V3H)
- SoftPos: accept card payments on the phone, no separate card reader required
- Offline: cash receipts continue without internet; they transmit to myDATA when the connection returns
- No daily Z-report
- Receipts include fiscal QR code
- Optional hardware: SUNMI devices with NFC, printer, 3-year warranty; Viva.com on selected models

## Pricing (EUR, cancel anytime, no hidden fees)

| Plan | Price | Retail receipts / month | Wholesale docs / month |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | €6 / month | 100 | 5 |
| Standard | €12 / month | 300 | 15 |
| Premium | €18 / month | 600 | 30 |
| All in One | €120 / year (~€10 / month) | Unlimited | 50 + Back Office included |

Comparison: a physical cash register typically costs €400–€800 plus ~€120 / year maintenance.

## Differentiators

1. Price floor of €6 / month — no €400–€800 hardware purchase.
2. SoftPos on the phone — card payments without a separate reader.
3. Semantic Software installed base: 40,000+ users and 400+ partners in Greece.

## Who it is for

Retail, take-away / food service, tourism (vehicle/boat rental), beauty, tradespeople, health professionals, transport, farmers & producers, entertainment & photography — anyone required to issue retail receipts when they do not already have an ERP-linked fiscal device.

## Optional hardware (not required)

- SUNMI P3 POS — card + NFC, 58mm printer, 4G/WiFi, 4GB RAM, Viva.com
- SUNMI P3 MIX — 10.1" screen, card + NFC, 50mm printer, Viva.com
- SUNMI V3H POS — 50mm printer, NFC, SIM, 4GB RAM
